info.title: Frankfurter
info.description: Reference exchange rates published by the European Central Bank. No key, no sign-up and no rate limit, which is what makes it the example: load it, find an operation, call it, and read a real response.

get.summary: Every currency the bank publishes, as code and name
The most recent rates, quoted against one base currency

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: the currency the rates are quoted in; EUR when omitted

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: comma-separated currencies to return; every one when omitted

200.description: the rates, the base they are quoted in, and the date they were published

get.summary: The rates published on one date, or the last publication before it

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: an ISO date, or two joined by `..` for a series

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: the currency the rates are quoted in; EUR when omitted

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: comma-separated currencies to return; every one when omitted

200.description: the rates published on or before that date
